compare.noCommon: There are no zones in common with the current tariff, so it could not be compared.
compare.hint: Median price of the same zones. A ratio outside 0.5–2× usually means the wrong currency or service.

fileHelp.title: Which file should I upload?
fileHelp.p1: Upload your own contract price list; you can ask your carrier representative for it. The general list prices on the website will not match your invoices.
fileHelp.p2: It must be for shipments from your country, with weights in kg or dimensional weight and the same currency as your invoices.
fileHelp.p3: The Excel template is the quickest option; a PDF sent by the carrier works too.

ai.loading: AI is reviewing the file… this usually takes 10–40 seconds.
ai.off: AI check is not available right now; automatic checks were run.
ai.failed: The AI check could not be completed.
ai.busy: AI is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

guide.suggest_invoices_one: Because your invoices use {{name}}, the table for this service was selected. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.suggest_invoices_other: Because your invoices use {{name}}, {{formatted}} tables for this service were selected; each covers a different country group, and you need all of them to cover every country. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.suggest_tariff_one: Because your tariff is for {{name}}, the table for this service was selected. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.suggest_tariff_other: Because your tariff is for {{name}}, {{formatted}} tables for this service were selected; each covers a different country group, and you need all of them to cover every country. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.suggest_default_one: Recommended: the table for {{name}} was selected. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.suggest_default_other: Recommended: {{formatted}} tables for {{name}} were selected; each covers a different country group, and you need all of them to cover every country. If this is the only service you use, continue without changing the selection.
guide.regions: The Dünya (World) and Avrupa (Europe) tables are different country groups of the same service.
guide.single: A tariff should contain a single service; if you also use another service (e.g. Economy), create a separate tariff for it.

pricing.listDiscountDesc: Exact calculation based on the contract: the list prices (p. {{list}}) are reduced by the rate in the discount table (p. {{discount}}). Invoices are calculated the same way.
pricing.netDesc: Ready-made discounted table (p. {{pages}}). It gives an approximate value only and may differ slightly from the invoice.
pricing.differ: The two methods differ in {{differing}} of {{compared}} prices (by up to {{max}}); the difference is mostly at intermediate weights.
pricing.same: Both methods give the same result for all {{compared}} prices.
pricing.unlinked_one: One table has no list-price counterpart; it is taken at its own price.
pricing.unlinked_other: {{formatted}} tables have no list-price counterpart; they are taken at their own prices.

pdf.mixed: The selected tables belong to different services ({{services}}). For the same zone and weight, one overwrites the other and the comparison comes out wrong. Keep a single service in this tariff and create a separate tariff for the other.
pdf.takeCountryZones: Also take the country → zone list
pdf.scanAiOff: AI scanning is not available right now.
pdf.noTablesNoAi: The tables in this PDF could not be read automatically and AI reading is off. Upload the price list as Excel or CSV, or enter the prices in the template.
pdf.leadTextNoAi: Tables are read automatically and this takes a few seconds.
pdf.leadImageNoAi: This PDF looks like a scanned image and AI reading is off. Upload the price list as Excel or CSV.
